text:
According to the onboarding documentation, Hermes Agent already supports DingTalk image delivery via Markdown image syntax:

* **DingTalk Images:** Markdown image links (`![image](url)`) are formatted for rich-text delivery in DingTalk.

Ensure the agent formats the image using standard Markdown image syntax (`![alt text](image_url)`), which the DingTalk gateway is configured to process and deliver as rich text.
